description: This file contains unit tests for the LocalizedDateFormatter class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing date formatting and localization features with various date formats and localization maps.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatterTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LocalizedDateFormatter class in the context of date localization and formatting.

methods.name: testFormatDate
methods.description: Tests the formatting of various dates with specific formats and localization mappings, asserting the expected localized date output.

methods.name: dataProviderForFormatDate
methods.description: Provides various test cases with dates, formats, localization maps, and expected outputs to test date formatting behavior.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithCachingForSameFormat
methods.description: Tests caching behavior when formatting dates with the same format multiple times, verifying that external translation calls are minimized.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithCachingForDifferentFormat
methods.description: Tests caching behavior when formatting dates with different formats, ensuring translation calls are made for each format.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithNonLocalizableFormat
methods.description: Verifies that when the format does not include localizable components, the translation method is not called, and formatting occurs normally.
